root_idea.summary: The root centers on gathering or massing something into elevation: a mountain is an elevated mass, and related words extend this idea to large groups, substantial physical form, innate constitution, and fixedness.
root_idea.development: The concrete sense of an elevated mass develops into meanings of magnitude, a great company, natural formation or disposition, bodily coarseness, and figurative immovability. Derived verbal uses also extend the root to creating someone with a disposition, entering or approaching a mountain, and encountering a hard obstruction.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular noun جَبَلٌ; the Quranic occurrences include both singular and plural inflections.
Displayed under the normalized noun جِبِلَّةٌ, which accounts for the two QAC occurrences and their constitution and multitude readings.

senses.definition: A mountain; a substantial elevated or rocky mass.
senses.usage_conditions: Used literally for a mountain or rocky elevation, in both singular and plural forms. Contextual renderings such as “hill” reflect the passage context rather than a separate lexical sense.

senses.definition: Innate constitution, natural disposition, or the created nature in which beings are formed.
senses.usage_conditions: In 26:184, the expression refers to the earlier created beings or to beings constituted according to their innate dispositions.

senses.definition: A great company, multitude, or people.
senses.usage_conditions: In 36:62, the form is understood through the related classical readings as a large company or multitude.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To create or form someone, especially to endow the person with a disposition toward something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction جَبَلَهُ عَلَى كَذَا means to create, adapt, or dispose someone by nature toward a thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To compel or constrain someone to do something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explained as a figurative extension of being created with a disposition so strong that it operates like compulsion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become mountain-like in size, thickness, coarseness, or roughness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form I use describing a person or thing that acquires substantial or rough form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Blunt or unable to penetrate, especially of iron, a blade, or a tool.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to iron and to the heads or blades of arrows, spears, swords, and axes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To descend to, settle in, or sojourn in a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III verb describing residence or settlement in mountainous terrain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come, go, or betake oneself to a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV verb of movement toward a mountain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reach hard ground or stone while digging.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV use describing a digger encountering a hard obstruction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To encounter difficulty or blockage in expression, producing no original or fresh diction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV use concerning a poet or verbal composition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fail to attain a sought or desired thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of seeking something and falling short of obtaining it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refuse or withhold something when asked, and not give it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV use of refusal or non-compliance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find someone fixed and niggardly, or to describe a niggard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use associating fixedness with stinginess.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter a mountain or the mountains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V verb; it may describe a group entering mountainous terrain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thick, coarse, rough, or not finely made; by extension, substantial in build or left thick rather than finely pared.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to physical build, bodily make, a hump, an arrow, or an object such as a sword that has not been made thin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The court or open area of a house.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use synonymous with سَاحَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dry trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal use reported for the vocalized form جُبْلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Much or numerous; a large or numerous group, such as a tribe or herd.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can describe abundant property or cattle as well as a numerous human group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rock, stone, or rocky tract, including a hard mass encountered by a digger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader concrete use related to the mountain sense; it can apply to a rocky elevation that is not a full mountain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An immovable or firmly settled person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of جَبَلٌ for someone who does not move from his place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lord, chief, or learned man of a people or company.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative social use of the mountain noun for a person of prominence or authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A serpent, literally associated with the mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression based on the serpent's habit of remaining in mountainous places.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity or misfortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use reported as an assumed tropical extension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow made from the nabʿ tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation connected with the tree's association with the mountain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An echo.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use reported for the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The face, its skin, or the outward-facing part of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can denote the visible or outward aspect turned toward an observer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vice, fault, defect, or blemish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal use of the vocalized form جَبْلَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strength.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use reported independently from the senses of face and constitution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hardness of the earth or ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use referring specifically to the hardness of soil or terrain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel's hump.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use for the raised mass of a camel's back.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The origin, stock, or underlying formation of a created thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical use of جِبْلَةٌ for what something is constituted from or derived from.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The fundamental nature or composition of a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use referring to a mountain's constitution rather than to innate disposition generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quality of a garment's thread and weaving.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression ثَوْبٌ جَيِّدُ الجِبْلَةِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large, thick, coarse, or rough man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived nominal use describing substantial physical build.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mountainous; of or relating to a mountain or mountains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributive adjective contrasted with سُهْلِيٌّ, “of the plain.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Natural, innate, essential, or resulting from the original constitution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributive adjective for qualities arising from the Creator-ordered natural disposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The body, with or without its bodily members.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative plural use likening bodily mass to a mountain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man with a bad or ugly face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival use concerning facial appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Much, abundance, a large quantity or number, or—more broadly—anything in substantial amount.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general quantitative use distinct from the Quranic constitution sense of جِبِلَّةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Large, big, or substantial in physical make.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man figuratively as though he were a mountain.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Reaching hard ground or stone while digging.
Difficulty and lack of originality in diction.
Failing to attain a sought thing.
Much or numerous, including a numerous tribe.
Mountain and the related rock or stone use.
Chief or learned man of a group.
Origin or stock of a created thing.

cautions: The QAC group for جِبِلَّةٌ includes the occurrence at 36:62, while the lexical evidence records several related classical readings there, including جِبِلٌّ; the multitude sense is therefore presented with an explicit reading/form caution rather than treated as identical to the constitution sense.
Lane's Quran citation for the multitude sense uses historical citation notation; the modern location used here is supplied independently by QAC.
